statute_note: Re-finalized: moved generation from the two-column PDF parser to the HTML edition, section-by-section verified against the prior parse. Restored section 68A (absent from the HTML edition, present in the registry's PDF with its own inline amendment marker; the amending Act No. 20 of 2024 itself is not in this corpus so this could not go through parse_amendment_pdf.py). Fixed 6 stray-space HTML typos. The switch also resolves two previously-documented parser defects: the section 88/89 heading-bleed and the phantom duplicate section-28 node. Amendment-chain files and reconciliation were added during a separate PDF-baseline finalization pass (2026-09-05) and merged here; that pass's hand-corrected PDF tree was superseded by this HTML-derived tree.

amendment_reconciliation.title: not held (chain header only: 'Act Nos, ... 53 of 1949')
amendment_reconciliation.reason: Named second in both chain headers and marked ten times in the baseline ('[2, 53 of 1949]' on s.8 among others); no copy on disk, so its operations cannot be checked against its own text.

amendment_reconciliation.title: Mortgage (Amendment) Act, No. 11 of 1953, Date of Assent: March 17, 1953 (scan title page); OCR: 'AN ACT TO AMEND THE MORTGAGE ACT, No. 6 OF 1949'
amendment_reconciliation.reason: Named in both chain headers; the baseline marks s.115 (Rules) '[3, 11 of 1953]'. OCR of the scan shows s.2 amending s.69 (repeal of subsections (2) and (3), renumbering) and s.3 inserting a new s.114A (Rules). Not applied again.

amendment_reconciliation.title: Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Act, No. 24 of 1969, Date of Assent: June 25, 1969 (scan title page); HTML: 'AN ACT TO AMEND THE CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE AND TO EFFECT CONSEQUENTIAL AMENDMENTS IN OTHER WRITTEN LAWS'
amendment_reconciliation.reason: Named in both chain headers as a consequential amendment; the baseline marks s.26 '[4, 24 of 1969]'. The Act's own text (4 sections) amends Civil Procedure Code sections and the Stamp Ordinance and, in s.4, directs that references in other written laws to estates of two thousand five hundred rupees be read as twenty thousand rupees; it does not name the Mortgage Act. Not applied again.

amendment_reconciliation.title: MORTGAGE (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 27 OF 1987 [Certified on 21st May, 1987] (scan title page); HTML: 'AN ACT TO AMEND THE MORTGAGE ACT.'
amendment_reconciliation.reason: Named in both chain headers; the baseline marks s.114 '[2, 27 of 1987]'; the Act's one operation substitutes the sitting fee in s.114(5). Not applied again.

amendment_reconciliation.title: MORTGAGE (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 3 OF 1990 [Certified on 6th March 1990] (scan title page); HTML: 'AN ACT TO AMEND THE MORTGAGE ACT'
amendment_reconciliation.reason: Named in both chain headers; 10 markers in the baseline; substitutes s.46 and inserts 47A, 62A-62H and 68A. Not applied again.
